caption: The drawing depicts three views of a transparent, light blue-green glass bottle with an oval, flask-like shape and a short cylindrical neck. The largest image, positioned centrally at the bottom, shows the bottle from the front with the words “ALBANY GLASS WORKS N.Y.” embossed in an arch on the front surface. Above and to the left, there is a smaller frontal view of the bottle showing an embossed portrait of a person in relief, visible on the flat side of the bottle. Above and to the right, a side view of the same bottle appears, displaying its ribbed edges and narrow profile. All three depictions use shades of blue and green with white highlights to indicate the glass’s transparency and reflective properties. There is a short horizontal scale near the bottom left, and the artist’s signature, “Chris Osborne,” is located in the bottom right corner. The background is a plain off-white color.
title: Flask
